column1: # ZAP baseline scan rule configuration for the DentistDSS gateway DAST job.
# Policy: everything is WARN by default. Only verified-noise rule IDs are
# IGNOREd here. The job's pass/fail gate is the explicit jq check for
# risk=="High" alerts in report.json — it does NOT rely on this file, so
# FAIL entries are unnecessary and real High findings fail the job regardless.
# Real findings are fixed in code, never masked by adding IGNORE entries.
